name: Ngaoundéré
description: Ngaoundéré is the capital of Cameroon's Adamaoua Region and a transport gateway between the south and the north. Individual waterfalls, lakes or hotels around the town are not listed here unless an official site sheet is added.
culture: Adamaoua is a highland region. This entry records only the role of Ngaoundéré as regional capital, not unsourced tourist-circuit claims.
